name: get_runtime_errors
description: Retrieves the most recent runtime errors that have occurred in the active Dart or Flutter application. Requires an active DTD connection.

appUri.description: The app URI to get runtime errors from. Required if multiple apps are connected.

clearRuntimeErrors.description: This is useful to clear out old errors that may no longer be relevant before reading them again.
clearRuntimeErrors.title: Whether to clear the runtime errors after retrieving them.
